definitions.explanation: The night sky filled with visible stars.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{上|うえ}から{見|み}た{星空|ほしぞら}は{本当|ほんとう}に{綺麗|きれい}だった。
examples.english: The starry sky seen from the mountaintop was truly beautiful.

examples.japanese: {星空|ほしぞら}を{眺|なが}めながら{話|はな}した。
examples.english: We talked while gazing at the starry sky.

examples.japanese: {満天|まんてん}の{星空|ほしぞら}の{下|した}でキャンプをした。
examples.english: We camped under a sky full of stars.

notes:
{星空|ほしぞら} refers to a starry sky. {星|ほし} means 'star' and {空|そら} means 'sky.'

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {星空|ほしぞら}を{見上|みあ}げる: to look up at the starry sky
- {星空|ほしぞら}を{眺|なが}める: to gaze at the starry sky
- {満天|まんてん}の{星空|ほしぞら}: sky full of stars
- {星空|ほしぞら}{観察|かんさつ}: stargazing
- {星空|ほしぞら}の{下|した}で: under the starry sky

RELATED WORDS:
- {夜空|よぞら}: night sky
- {天|あま}の{川|がわ}: Milky Way
- {星座|せいざ}: constellation
- {流|なが}れ{星|ぼし}: shooting star

BEST VIEWING:
- {街|まち}の{明|あ}かりから{離|はな}れた{場所|ばしょ}: away from city lights
- {新月|しんげつ}の{夜|よる}: new moon nights
